note: Inactive Autologout is driven entirely by the inactive_autologout.settings config object: enable (0/1), timeout (seconds string, min 120, sent to JS as *1000 ms), role_based_timeout (0/1), modal_title, modal_text (@count is the countdown placeholder), plus dynamic <role_id> and <role_id>_timeout keys. Settings form route inactive_autologout.admin_settings_form at /admin/config/people/autologoutsettings, permission 'administer inactiveautologout'. hook_page_attachments attaches the user_autologout library only when enable=1 and the user is authenticated. Routes /autologout (user_logout + redirect), /autologout_active and /autologout_gettimestamp (AJAX activity tracking). Shipped defaults: timeout '120', enable 0, role_based_timeout 0, modal_title 'Session Expiring'. Medium cases read back the live enable/timeout and modal title; hard cases enable it with a 600s timeout and customise the warning modal title, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: How do I turn on automatic logout of idle users with the inactive_autologout Drupal module, and what is the minimum allowed timeout?
evals.expected_output: Enable the feature on the settings form at /admin/config/people/autologoutsettings (config inactive_autologout.settings: enable=1) and set the default idle Timeout in seconds. The timeout must be 120 seconds or greater (form-validated).

evals.prompt: In inactive_autologout, the warning modal shows a countdown before logging the user out. Which config keys hold the modal's title and text, and what placeholder inserts the live countdown number?
evals.expected_output: modal_title and modal_text (both in inactive_autologout.settings). Use @count in modal_text as the placeholder for the live countdown number (HTML is allowed).

evals.prompt: Can inactive_autologout give different idle timeouts to different roles? How is that configured?
evals.expected_output: Yes. Turn on role_based_timeout, then enable the specific role (a <role_id> flag) and set its <role_id>_timeout in seconds. At runtime the module uses the first enabled role's timeout for the user instead of the default timeout.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is inactive_autologout currently enabled, and what is the default inactivity timeout in seconds? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: It is enabled (enable=1) with a default timeout of 300 seconds, per inactive_autologout.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, what title text is configured for the inactive_autologout session-expiry warning modal? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: The modal title is 'Idle timeout warning ABC' (inactive_autologout.settings:modal_title).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use inactive_autologout to enable automatic logout of idle users and set the default inactivity timeout to 600 seconds. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: inactive_autologout.settings:enable = 1 and timeout = 600 (via the settings form at /admin/config/people/autologoutsettings or drush cset).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, change the inactive_autologout warning modal's title to exactly 'Your session is about to expire', keeping the @count countdown placeholder in the modal text. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: inactive_autologout.settings:modal_title = 'Your session is about to expire' and modal_text still contains @count.
